number_is_finite_fn.brief: Number.isFinite：判断参数是否为有限数字 / Number.isFinite: test whether the argument is a finite number

number_is_finite_fn.return: 是有限数字返回 true / true when the value is a finite number

number_is_nan_fn.brief: Number.isNaN：判断参数是否为数值 NaN / Number.isNaN: test whether the argument is the numeric NaN

params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为待测值 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the value under test
params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored

number_is_nan_fn.return: 是 NaN 返回 true / true when the value is NaN
number_is_nan_fn.note: 仅当类型为 `number` 且 `v != v` 时为真，不做类型转换 / True only when the type is `number` and `v != v`, with no coercion

number_is_safe_integer.brief: Number.isSafeInteger：判断参数是否为安全整数 / Number.isSafeInteger: test whether the argument is a safe integer

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored

number_is_safe_integer.return: 是安全整数返回 true / true when the value is a safe integer
number_is_safe_integer.note: 要求类型为 `number`、`floor(v)==v` 且 |v| ≤ 2^53-1 / Requires type `number`, `floor(v)==v` and |v| ≤ 2^53-1

bool_this_valueOf.brief: Boolean.prototype.valueOf：取布尔接收者的原始布尔值 / Boolean.prototype.valueOf: return the primitive boolean of the receiver

params.argc: 实参个数，忽略 / Argument count; ignored

bool_this_valueOf.return: 原始布尔值 / The primitive boolean value
bool_this_valueOf.note: 接收者已是布尔则直接返回；是对象时取内部 `__prim`；否则对接收者做数值转换后判非零 / Returns the receiver when already boolean, reads the internal `__prim` for objects, otherwise coerces the receiver to a number and tests it against zero

bool_this_toString.brief: Boolean.prototype.toString：返回 `true` 或 `false` / Boolean.prototype.toString: return `true` or `false`

params.a: 实参数组，忽略 / Argument array; ignored
params.argc: 实参个数，忽略 / Argument count; ignored

bool_this_toString.return: `true` 或 `false` 字符串 / The string `true` or `false`
bool_this_toString.note: 基于 js_truthy 判定接收者的真值 / The receiver's truthiness is decided by js_truthy

number_this_toString_radix.brief: Number.prototype.toString 的基数版本（占位实现）/ Radix-aware Number.prototype.toString (placeholder implementation)

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored

jsbuf_init.brief: 初始化字符串输出缓冲 / Initialise a string output buffer
jsbuf_init.details: 容量固定为 256 字节并分配堆内存，`len` 清零，缓冲区置为空串 / The capacity starts at 256 bytes, heap memory is allocated, `len` is zeroed and the buffer is set to the empty string.

params.b: inout:待初始化的字符串缓冲 / String buffer to initialise

jsbuf_init.note: 使用完毕必须调用 jsbuf_free 释放 / The caller must release it with jsbuf_free

jsbuf_add.brief: 向字符串缓冲追加指定字节数 / Append bytes to a string buffer
jsbuf_add.details: 缓冲不足时容量反复翻倍再 realloc，随后拷贝 `n` 字节并补写结尾 NUL / When the buffer is too small the capacity is doubled repeatedly and realloc'd, then `n` bytes are copied and a trailing NUL is written.

params.b: inout:目标字符串缓冲 / Target string buffer
params.s: 要追加的字节 / Bytes to append
params.n: 要追加的字节数（可为 0）/ Number of bytes to append (may be 0)

jsbuf_add.note: 缓冲未成功分配（`b->s` 为 `NULL`）时直接返回 / Returns immediately when the buffer was never allocated (`b->s` is `NULL`)

jsbuf_free.brief: 释放字符串输出缓冲 / Free a string output buffer

params.b: inout:要释放的字符串缓冲 / String buffer to release

jsbuf_free.note: 释放后把 `b->s` 置为 `NULL`，可安全重复调用 / After freeing, `b->s` is set to `NULL` so repeated calls are safe

json_quote.brief: 按 JSON 语法给字符串加引号并转义 / Quote and escape a string per the JSON grammar
json_quote.details: 处理 `"`、`\` 与 `\n \r \t \b \f` 等控制字符；其余小于 0x20 的字节转成 `\u00xx`，高位 UTF-8 字节原样输出 / Handles `"`, `\` and the control escapes `\n \r \t \b \f`; other bytes below 0x20 become `\u00xx` and multi-byte UTF-8 is copied verbatim.

params.b: inout:JSON 输出缓冲 / JSON output buffer
params.s: 要转义的字符串，`NULL` 视作空串 / String to escape; `NULL` is treated as the empty string

json_is_function.brief: 判断值是否为函数或原生对象 / Test whether a value is a function or a native object

params.v: 待检查的值 / Value to inspect

json_is_function.return: 是函数或原生对象返回 1，否则返回 0 / 1 for a function or native object, otherwise 0
json_is_function.note: 这类值不可序列化，JSON.stringify 时按 `null` 处理 / Such values are not serialisable and become `null` in JSON.stringify

json_write_array.brief: 把数组序列化为 `[e, ...]` / Serialise an array as `[e, ...]`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.b: inout:JSON 输出缓冲 / JSON output buffer
params.o: 要序列化的数组对象 / The array object to serialise

json_write_array.note: 按索引逐个写出，包括空洞 / Elements are written index by index, holes included

json_write_object.brief: 把对象序列化为 `{"k":v, ...}` / Serialise an object as `{"k":v, ...}`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.b: inout:JSON 输出缓冲 / JSON output buffer
params.v: 被序列化的对象值 / The object value being serialised
params.o: 对象本体 / The underlying object
params.depth: 当前递归深度 / Current recursion depth

json_write_object.note: 遍历自有键，跳过值为 `undefined` 或函数的属性 / Walks own keys and skips properties whose value is `undefined` or a function

json_write_date.brief: 把 Date 实例序列化为其 toJSON() 结果 / Serialise a Date instance as its toJSON() result

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.b: inout:JSON 输出缓冲 / JSON output buffer
params.depth: 当前递归深度 / Current recursion depth

json_write_date.return: 成功的状态码，透传自 json_write / A status code propagated from json_write
json_write_date.note: 存在可调用的 `toJSON` 时调用并继续写出，否则直接输出 `js_to_string(v)` 的带引号形式 / When a callable `toJSON` exists it is invoked and its result written; otherwise the quoted `js_to_string(v)` is emitted

json_write.brief: 递归写出任意值的 JSON 表示 / Recursively write the JSON representation of any value
json_write.details: `undefined`/`null` 写 `null`；布尔写 `true`/`false`；数字写数值串，NaN 与 ±Infinity 写 `null`；字符串加引号；对象按数组、函数、Date、普通对象分派；其他类型统一写 `null` / `undefined`/`null` become `null`; booleans become `true`/`false`; numbers are written as numeric strings with NaN and ±Infinity as `null`; strings are quoted; objects dispatch to array, function, Date or plain-object handling; everything else writes `null`.

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.b: inout:JSON 输出缓冲 / JSON output buffer
params.v: 待序列化的值 / Value to serialise
params.depth: 当前递归深度 / Current recursion depth

json_write.return: 写出成功返回 1；深度超过 64 层返回 0 以中断循环引用 / 1 on success; returns 0 once the depth exceeds 64 to break out of circular references

retval.0: 递归过深，判定为循环结构 / Recursion too deep, treated as a circular structure

json_stringify.brief: JSON.stringify：把首个参数序列化为 JSON 字符串 / JSON.stringify: serialise the first argument to a JSON string

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为待序列化值 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the value to serialise

json_stringify.return: JSON 字符串；参数为 `undefined` 时返回 `undefined` / The JSON string, or `undefined` when the argument is `undefined`
json_stringify.note: 检测到循环结构（json_write 返回 0）时抛出 “Converting circular structure to JSON” / Throws “Converting circular structure to JSON” when json_write signals a circular structure with 0

json_ws.brief: 跳过 JSON 文本中的空白字符 / Skip whitespace in the JSON text

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor

json_ws.note: 空白包括空格、制表、换行与回车 / Whitespace covers space, tab, newline and carriage return

json_str_grow.brief: 把 JSON 解码临时缓冲容量翻倍 / Double the capacity of the JSON decode scratch buffer

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor
params.buf: inout:解码缓冲指针 / Decode scratch buffer pointer
params.n: 已写入的字节数，拷贝时保留 / Bytes already written, preserved by the copy

json_str_unicode.brief: 把 `\uXXXX` 转义解码为 UTF-8 / Decode a `\uXXXX` escape to UTF-8
json_str_unicode.details: 最多读取四个十六进制数字并推进游标，随后把码点编码为 UTF-8 追加到缓冲 / Reads up to four hex digits while advancing the cursor, then appends the UTF-8 encoding of the code point.

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor
params.buf: inout:解码缓冲指针 / Decode scratch buffer pointer
params.n: inout:已写入字节计数 / Bytes-written counter

json_str_unicode.note: 代理对不做合并，单个 `\uD800` 会原样单独编码 / Surrogate pairs are not combined; a lone `\uD800` is encoded on its own

json_escape_simple.brief: 解析单字符转义序列 / Resolve a single-character escape sequence

params.e: 反斜杠后的转义字符 / The escape character following the backslash
params.c: 转义字符本身，作为默认回退 / The escape character itself, used as the fallback

json_escape_simple.return: 转义对应的实际字符 / The actual character the escape stands for
json_escape_simple.note: 只识别 `n t r b f`；其余情况原样返回第二个参数，配合宽容解析器不报错 / Only `n t r b f` are recognised; anything else returns the second argument unchanged so the tolerant parser never rejects it

json_parse_string.brief: 解析一个 JSON 字符串字面量 / Parse one JSON string literal

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor

json_parse_string.return: 解析出的 JS 字符串 / The parsed JS string
json_parse_string.note: 处理 `\uXXXX` 与单字符转义；未闭合引号时以当前缓冲内容结束 / Handles `\uXXXX` and single-character escapes; unterminated quotes end at the current buffer content

json_parse_array.brief: 解析一个 JSON 数组 / Parse a JSON array

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor

json_parse_array.return: 解析出的 JS 数组对象 / The parsed JS array object
json_parse_array.note: 元素之间以 `,` 分隔，遇到 `]` 结束 / Elements are separated by `,` and terminated by `]`

json_parse_object.brief: 解析一个 JSON 对象 / Parse a JSON object

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor

json_parse_object.return: 解析出的 JS 普通对象 / The parsed JS plain object
json_parse_object.note: 键必须是带引号的字符串，否则抛出 “JSON.parse: expected a property name” / Keys must be quoted strings, otherwise “JSON.parse: expected a property name” is thrown

json_parse_value.brief: 递归下降解析一个 JSON 值 / Recursively parse one JSON value
json_parse_value.details: 先跳过空白，再按首字符分派：`{`→对象、`[`→数组、`"`→字符串、`true`/`false`/`null` 字面量，其余交给 `strtod` 解析数字（含负数与小数）/ Leading whitespace is skipped, then the first character dispatches: `{` to object, `[` to array, `"` to string, the `true`/`false`/`null` literals, and everything else to `strtod` for numbers (including negatives and fractions).

params.j: inout:JSON 解析游标 / JSON parser cursor

json_parse_value.return: 解析出的 JS 值 / The parsed JS value
json_parse_value.note: 数字无法解析时抛出 “JSON.parse: unexpected token”；本函数是整个 JSON.parse 的递归入口，构成对象/数组的互相递归 / Throws “JSON.parse: unexpected token” when the number cannot be parsed; this is the recursion entry point of the whole JSON.parse and mutually recurses with the object and array parsers

json_parse.brief: JSON.parse：把首个参数解析为 JS 值 / JSON.parse: parse the first argument into a JS value

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为待解析文本 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the text to parse

json_parse.return: 解析得到的 JS 值 / The parsed JS value
json_parse.note: 入参先做字符串转换，随后交给 json_parse_value / The argument is coerced to a string before being handed to json_parse_value

regex_obj_new.brief: 构造一个 RegExp 对象 / Create a RegExp object

params.pattern: 模式串，`NULL` 视作空串 / Pattern string; `NULL` is treated as the empty string
params.flags: 标志串，`NULL` 视作空串 / Flag string; `NULL` is treated as the empty string

regex_obj_new.return: 新建的 RegExp 值 / The newly created RegExp value

regex_last_index.brief: 读取正则对象的 lastIndex / Read a regex object's lastIndex

params.thisv: 正则对象 / The regex object

regex_last_index.return: 非负的 lastIndex 整数（缺省或非正时为 0）/ The non-negative lastIndex as an int, or 0 when missing or not positive

regex_set_last_index.brief: 写回正则对象的 lastIndex / Write back a regex object's lastIndex

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.thisv: 正则对象 / The regex object
params.v: 新的 lastIndex 值 / The new lastIndex value

regex_set_last_index.note: 接收者不是对象时不做任何处理 / Does nothing when the receiver is not an object

regex_make_result.brief: 由捕获下标构造正则匹配结果数组 / Build a regex match-result array from capture indices
regex_make_result.details: 首元素为整体匹配子串；其后每个捕获组对应一个元素（未参与匹配时为 `undefined`）；再附加 `index`、`input`、`groups` 属性 / The first element is the whole match, each capture group follows (as `undefined` when unmatched), and `index`, `input` and `groups` are attached as extra properties.

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.s: 被匹配的输入字符串 / The input string that was matched
params.caps: 捕获下标数组，`caps[0]`/`caps[1]` 为整体匹配起止 / Capture index array; `caps[0]`/`caps[1]` bound the whole match
params.total: 捕获组个数 / Number of capture groups

regex_make_result.return: 匹配结果数组 / The match-result array
regex_make_result.note: `caps[0]` 被钳制到 ≥0，`caps[1]` 被钳制到字符串长度 / `caps[0]` is clamped to ≥0 and `caps[1]` to the string length

regex_test.brief: RegExp.prototype.test：测试输入是否含匹配 / RegExp.prototype.test: test whether the input contains a match

params.thisv: 正则对象接收者 / The regex receiver
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为被测试文本 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the text under test

regex_test.return: 存在匹配返回 true，否则 false / true when a match exists, otherwise false
regex_test.note: 全局正则从 lastIndex 起搜，失败时把 lastIndex 复位为 0，成功时更新为匹配起点 / A global regex searches from lastIndex, resets it to 0 on failure and stores the match start on success

regex_exec.brief: RegExp.prototype.exec：执行一次匹配并返回结果 / RegExp.prototype.exec: perform one match and return the result

params.thisv: 正则对象接收者 / The regex receiver
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为输入文本 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the input text

regex_exec.return: 匹配结果数组；未匹配返回 `null` / The match-result array, or `null` when there is no match
regex_exec.note: 全局正则维护并更新 lastIndex；结果由 regex_make_result 生成 / A global regex maintains and updates lastIndex; the result is produced by regex_make_result

js_regex_new.brief: 由正则字面量创建 RegExp 对象 / Create a RegExp object from a regex literal

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

js_regex_new.return: 与 `new RegExp` 等价的 RegExp 值 / A RegExp value equivalent to `new RegExp`
js_regex_new.note: 内部直接转发到 regex_obj_new / Internally forwards straight to regex_obj_new

regex_toString.brief: RegExp.prototype.toString：返回 `/模式/标志` 形式 / RegExp.prototype.toString: return the `/pattern/flags` form

params.thisv: 正则对象接收者 / The regex receiver
params.a: 实参数组，忽略 / Argument array; ignored
params.argc: 实参个数，忽略 / Argument count; ignored

regex_toString.return: 形如 `/pat/flags` 的字符串 / A string of the form `/pat/flags`
regex_toString.note: `source` 与 `flags` 缺失时按空串处理 / Missing `source` and `flags` are treated as empty strings

repl_expand.details: `$$` 产生字面 `$`；`$&` 整个匹配；`$n` 第 n 组（超出范围或未匹配则跳过）；`` $` `` 匹配前的文本；`$'` 匹配后的文本；其他 `$x` 原样输出 `$` / `$$` yields a literal `$`; `$&` is the whole match; `$n` is capture n (skipped when out of range or unmatched); `` $` `` is the text before the match; `$'` is the text after it; any other `$x` emits a literal `$`.

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.rep: 替换模板（以 NUL 结尾）/ The replacement template, NUL-terminated
params.s: 被替换的原始输入 / The original input being replaced
params.caps: 捕获下标数组 / Capture index array
params.total: 捕获组个数 / Number of capture groups

repl_expand.note: 本函数只处理模板；回调形式的替换由 repl_append_match 处理 / This handles the template form only; callback-style replacement is handled by repl_append_match

repl_call_args.brief: 为替换回调构造实参数组 / Build the argument array for a replacement callback

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.s: 被替换的原始输入 / The original input being replaced
params.caps: 捕获下标数组 / Capture index array
params.total: 捕获组个数 / Number of capture groups

repl_call_args.return: 长度为 total+3 的实参数组：整体匹配、各捕获组（未匹配为 `undefined`）、偏移、输入字符串 / An argument array of length total+3: the whole match, each capture group (`undefined` when unmatched), the offset, then the input string

repl_append_match.brief: 把单次匹配的替换结果追加到输出缓冲 / Append the replacement for one match to the output buffer

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.rep: 替换值，可为回调 / The replacement value, possibly a callback
params.rep_s: 替换模板字符串（rep 非回调时使用）/ The replacement template string, used when `rep` is not callable
params.s: 被替换的原始输入 / The original input being replaced
params.caps: 捕获下标数组 / Capture index array
params.total: 捕获组个数 / Number of capture groups

repl_append_match.note: `rep` 可调用时以其返回值经字符串转换后追加，否则按模板展开 / When `rep` is callable its result is coerced to a string and appended; otherwise the template is expanded

string_replace_regex.brief: 用正则替换：非全局只替换首个匹配 / Replace with a RegExp needle: only the first match unless global
string_replace_regex.details: 每次搜索后写入匹配前的文本、追加替换结果；全局正则会持续前进，空匹配时前移一个字节以推进 / Before each match the preceding text is copied and the replacement appended; a global regex keeps advancing, and an empty match moves forward one byte to make progress.

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.s: 原始字符串 / The original string

string_from_char_code.note: 每个实参取低 16 位（`& 0xFFFF`）后编码为 UTF-8；BMP 以上的码位需由调用方用代理对表示 / Each argument is masked to its low 16 bits (`& 0xFFFF`) before UTF-8 encoding; code points above the BMP must be supplied as surrogate pairs by the caller

string_from_code_point.brief: String.fromCodePoint(...cp)：由码点构造字符串 / String.fromCodePoint(...cp): build a string from code points

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，每个元素为一个码点 / Argument array; each element is one code point

string_from_code_point.return: 拼接后的字符串 / The concatenated string
string_from_code_point.note: 码点为 NaN、负数或大于 0x10FFFF 时抛出 `RangeError` / Throws a `RangeError` when a code point is NaN, negative or greater than 0x10FFFF

native_number_ctor.brief: Number(x)：把参数转换为数值 / Number(x): convert the argument to a number

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为待转换值 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the value to convert

native_number_ctor.return: 数值结果；无实参时返回 0 / The numeric result, or 0 when called with no arguments

native_boolean_ctor.brief: Boolean(x)：把参数转换为布尔值 / Boolean(x): convert the argument to a boolean

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为待转换值 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the value to convert

native_boolean_ctor.return: 布尔结果；按 js_truthy 判定 / The boolean result, decided by js_truthy
native_boolean_ctor.note: 无实参时返回 false / Returns false when called with no arguments

native_object_ctor.brief: Object(x)：包装或创建对象 / Object(x): wrap or create an object

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为待包装值 / Argument array; `a[0]` is the value to wrap

native_object_ctor.return: 有实参时原样返回该值；无实参时返回新建的空对象 / The argument returned as is when present, otherwise a freshly created empty object
native_object_ctor.note: 本实现不区分原始值包装与对象透传，两者都原样返回 / This implementation does not distinguish primitive wrapping from object passthrough and returns the argument unchanged in both cases

native_array_ctor.brief: Array(...args)：按长度或元素构造数组 / Array(...args): build an array from a length or from elements

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，`a[0]` 为唯一数值时视作长度 / Argument array; a single numeric `a[0]` is treated as the length

native_array_ctor.note: 单个数值实参时长度取 `floor` 且不小于 0，元素为空槽；否则各实参依次成为元素 / With a single numeric argument the length is `floor`'d and clamped to ≥0 leaving holes; otherwise the arguments become the elements

native_iter_symbol.brief: Symbol.iterator 的取值函数：返回一个空对象 / The Symbol.iterator accessor: return an empty object

params.thisv: 忽略 / Ignored
params.a: 实参数组，忽略 / Argument array; ignored
params.argc: 实参个数，忽略 / Argument count; ignored

native_iter_symbol.return: 新建的空对象 / A freshly created empty object
native_iter_symbol.note: 仅用于让 `obj[Symbol.iterator]` 的取值/存在性检查成立，不产生真实迭代器 / Only serves to make a `obj[Symbol.iterator]` read or existence check succeed; no real iterator is produced

utf8_strlen_n.brief: 统计字节区间内的 UTF-8 码点数 / Count the UTF-8 code points within a byte range

params.s: 以 NUL 结尾的字符串 / NUL-terminated string
params.bytes: 限制的字节数 / Byte limit

utf8_strlen_n.return: 区间内的码点个数 / The number of code points in the range
utf8_strlen_n.note: 遇到 NUL 或达到 `bytes` 即停止 / Stops at a NUL or once `bytes` is reached

string_split_regex.brief: 用正则分隔符切分，并按规范插入捕获组 / Split on a RegExp separator, interleaving capture groups per spec
string_split_regex.details: 在每次匹配处切出前一段作为元素，随后把每个捕获组依次插入结果，再推进搜索；`limit` 限制元素总数 / Each match contributes the preceding segment as an element followed by every capture group in turn, then the search advances; `limit` caps the total number of elements.

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.out: out:接收切分结果的数组 / The array receiving the split result
params.s: 被切分的字符串 / The string being split
params.sep: 正则分隔符 / The RegExp separator
params.limit: 元素个数上限，负数表示不限 / Maximum element count; negative means unlimited

string_split_regex.note: 空匹配时前进一个字节以避免死循环 / An empty match advances one byte to avoid spinning

string_split_plain.brief: 用普通字符串分隔符切分 / Split on a plain string separator

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.out: out:接收切分结果的数组 / The array receiving the split result
params.s: 被切分的字符串 / The string being split
params.sep: 分隔符（经字符串转换）/ The separator, coerced to a string
params.limit: 元素个数上限，负数表示不限 / Maximum element count; negative means unlimited

string_split_plain.note: 分隔符为空串时按码点逐字切分 / An empty separator splits the string into code points

string_split.brief: String.prototype.split：按分隔符切分字符串 / String.prototype.split: split a string by a separator

params.thisv: 接收字符串 / The receiver string
params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 分隔符、`a[1]` 上限 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the separator, `a[1]` the limit

string_split.return: 切分结果数组 / The array of split parts
string_split.note: 上限为 0 时返回空数组；分隔符为 `undefined` 时整串作为唯一元素 / A limit of 0 yields an empty array; an `undefined` separator makes the whole string the only element

string_concat.brief: String.prototype.concat：依次拼接实参并返回新串 / String.prototype.concat: append the arguments and return a new string

params.thisv: 接收字符串 / The receiver string
params.a: 实参数组，按顺序拼接 / Argument array, appended in order

string_concat.return: 拼接后的新字符串 / The concatenated string
string_concat.note: 每个实参都经 str_arg 做字符串转换；缓冲区按需成倍扩容 / Every argument is coerced by str_arg; the buffer grows by doubling as needed
